output.summary: Of the 16 tests, I'd keep 9 and remove 7. One of the 7 has confidence below 0.5, so it goes to a person rather than being removed. Every oracle matched the SRD text, including the Areas of Knowledge table in GLOSS.study. All tests I mutated failed when their rule was broken, with one exception: hold_person_on_a_goblin_doesnt_reveal_its_type still passed when the player log said 'Hold Person does nothing to Goblin Warrior'. The existing wolf no-hint test caught that same leak. Both red tests fail for the reason they state (KeyError at actions.py:337). They are the same defect, so I refuted the Session-path one at 0.45 to send it to a person. The other refutations are duplicates: the goblin Fey type (already in test_monsters), Hold Person on a goblin (already in test_monsters), Fey lore via Study (already in soc02 and the fourteen-types test), monster types on the list (covered by the every-monster test), and PC species vs type, which mostly repeats the sample-party test and guards a 2014 convention the SRD never mentions.
